question: Which NFA variant has the largest unit-cell volume in Table 1, and what is it?
rendered:
According to Table 1 in "Lithium Iron Aluminum Nickelate, LiNixFeyAlzO2—New Sustainable Cathodes for Next-Generation Cobalt-Free Li-Ion Batteries", the Fe-rich NFA has the largest unit-cell volume. 

The unit-cell volume of the Fe-rich NFA is 102.0574(2) Å^3.
